content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 8 to 10)
DELIVERIES BY SCOOTER (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This task looks at average speeds of deliveries made by scooter.
A company delivers orders from its warehouses to shops and houses. All deliveries of small parcels are made by scooter.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Meera rides a scooter that travels 12 km in 15 minutes on quiet roads. Show that her average speed on quiet roads is 48 km/h. [2]

content.tex: Meera rides a scooter that travels 12km in 15 minutes on quiet roads.
Show that her average speed on quiet roads is 48km/h.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) When the roads are busy the time for the 12 km journey is 30 minutes. Calculate her average speed on busy roads. ................................................. [2]

content.tex: When the roads are busy the time for the 12km journey is 30 minutes.
Calculate her average speed on busy roads.

parts.text: (c) Meera makes a delivery. She travels for 15 minutes on quiet roads and then for 30 minutes on busy roads. Calculate her average speed for the whole journey. ................................................. [2]
